shortDescription: Glencore LSE:GLEN said on Friday it now expects 2026 marketing adjusted operating profit to exceed $5 billion, ahead of its long-term guidance, citing a near-record first-half performance driven by reshaped crude oil, refined products, gas and freight markets.
